lines.name: CARD
lines.text:
Biscayne Card Room, off the causeway. Carpet from 1994, palms out front, coffee from this morning, maybe.
Twenty tables, every one of them a classroom.

lines.name: MILES
lines.text: Back again? Sign the list. The nightly turbo kicks off at seven.

lines.name: TOMMY
lines.text: Hey, you're the kid from Saturday. Don't get cocky. This room eats dreamers for breakfast.

lines.name: MUSTICH
lines.text: Cute hoodie. Did it come with the free seat?

lines.name: CARD
lines.text:
Mustich. Dad's money, a solver subscription, and a smile you want to wipe off.
He's been circling the Biscayne Classic all year.

lines.name: CARD
lines.text: Goal: the Biscayne Classic, Saturday, February 14. Build your bankroll to $5,000 before it.
